info.name: PhonePe PG V2 Autopay with TPV
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway V2 - Autopay Subscription Setup with TPV (Third-Party Validation).

Introduction: Sets up a UPI Autopay mandate restricted to pre-registered customer bank account(s) via a constraints[] array (BFSI use cases). Same subscription setup flow as standard Autopay, with account constraints added. Two setup modes: UPI Intent (returns intentUrl) and UPI Collect (pushes a mandate request to the customer VPA).

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Subscription Setup -> Setup (UPI Intent), Setup (UPI Collect)
- Status -> Subscription Order Status, Subscription Status
- Webhooks (Mock Server)

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically. Set account_number + ifsc to the allowed bank account.

Environments:
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/<Endpoint>
- Production: Authorization API https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/<Endpoint> ; Other APIs https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg/<Endpoint>

API Endpoints:
- Authorization              POST /v1/oauth/token
- Subscription Setup (TPV)   POST /subscriptions/v2/setup
- Subscription Order Status  GET  /subscriptions/v2/order/{merchantOrderId}/status
- Subscription Status        GET  /subscriptions/v2/{merchantSubscriptionId}/status

Docs: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/api-integration/api-reference/subscription-setuptvp

exec: throw new Error('Missing access_token. Run Authorization/Get Access Token first.');

request.description: Generate the O-Bearer access token required to authenticate all Autopay TPV requests.

Set up a UPI Autopay mandate (TPV) via UPI Intent. Returns orderId + intentUrl to open the chosen UPI app. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/api-integration/api-reference/subscription-setuptvp

Set up a UPI Autopay mandate (TPV) via UPI Collect. Returns orderId + state PENDING; the customer approves the mandate request in their UPI app. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/api-integration/api-reference/subscription-setuptvp
Fetch the setup order status by merchantOrderId. Poll until the mandate setup completes.
Fetch the mandate/subscription status by merchantSubscriptionId (ACTIVE once the mandate is set up).
